subject: Mutual Action Plan & final security conditions — BlueVault evaluation
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@bluevault.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Joe Chan <joe.chan@bluevault.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jan 2028 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual Action Plan & security gates for evaluation

Hi Neha / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — BlueVault is excited about Redwood's latency and cost profile. Before we lock the pilot, our InfoSec and Legal teams want a short, concrete mutual action plan that ties evaluation milestones to security deliverables. High-level asks from our side: 

- SOC 2: we need either the latest Type II report or a firm date when it will be available.
- SIG/CAIQ: a completed SIG baseline (completed or in-progress with outstanding controls called out).
- DPA: our legal team has a small redline (see attached docx).
- Data retention: confirmation of retention defaults for embeddings & logs, and any regional residency options.

Can you send a one-page MAP with target dates for each item and owners? We are trying to close procurement by 1/20; if security gating falls into that window we need clear acceptance criteria so our legal can sign off conditionally. 

Attachment: BV-SOC2-request-questions.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

Appreciate a timeline — Marta

--
Marta Ruiz
Security Program Manager | BlueVault
marta.ruiz@bluevault.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@bluevault.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Jan 2028 11:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & security gates for evaluation

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear asks. I put together a short MAP draft and a proposed acceptance checklist attached. Key commitments in the draft:

- SOC 2: Redwood will provide our most recent Type II report within 7 business days (or, if not available, a SOC readiness summary + remediation ETA).
- SIG/CAIQ: we'll return a completed SIG baseline within 5 business days; outstanding items will be marked as mitigations and owner-assigned.
- DPA: we reviewed BlueVault's redline and attached a tracked DPA response (see BlueVault-DPA-redline-20280110.docx).
- Data retention: default: embeddings 30 days, model cache 7 days, request logs 90 days. We can provide EU-only residency for keys/data on Dedicated/Private options — Soojin is looped to confirm technical controls.

I've included target dates in the MAP and proposed conditional acceptance language for procurement (legal can sign while SOC2 report is pending provided the SOC readiness summary + compensating controls are accepted). Vanessa — can you confirm the commercial fallback (credit/termination clause) if acceptance criteria aren't met by the last date (1/20)?

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-draft-20280109.pdf, BlueVault-DPA-redline-20280110.docx

Next steps I propose:
1) BlueVault confirms MAP target dates by EOD 1/10.
2) Redwood sends SOC readiness package + SIG baseline by 1/17.
3) Final DPA negotiation via redline and DocuSign after legal thumbs-up (aim to have countersigned DPA by 1/20).

If that sequence looks OK I will lock the MAP and send a Google Drive link to the final doc.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0183
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 08:09:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & security gates for evaluation

Marta / Neha — quick clarifying note from commercial: we can agree to conditional acceptance up to 1/20 with the following contract-level guardrails:

- If SOC 2 Type II is not delivered by 1/20, BlueVault may elect a 60-day extension to the acceptance window. During that extension Redwood will provide interim evidence (SOC readiness summary + SOC audit engagement letter).
- If SOC deliverables are not provided by extension end, BlueVault can terminate with a pro-rated refund for unused Dedicated capacity or a one-month service credit for Hosted usage.
- DPA redline: we are comfortable with BlueVault's data residency asks for EU-only on Dedicated/Private; for Hosted we'll offer contract-side assurances and optional customer-managed keys on Dedicated.

Soojin — can you confirm the technical path for EU-only residency and a short bullet list of controls we'll hand over to BlueVault for their evidentiary needs (log retention access, KMS attestations, audit logs, and runbook excerpts)? I attached a simple data-retention matrix to show defaults versus carveouts.

Attachment: data-retention-matrix.csv

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

Thanks — this is helpful. BlueVault legal reviewed the DPA redline and we uploaded a cleaned PDF; procurement is OK with conditional acceptance provided:

- Redwood posts the SOC readiness summary by 1/17 and the SIG baseline within 5 business days of that summary.
- Data residency confirmation (EU option) and KMS integration steps documented.
- DocuSign link for the conditional MSA/DPA so our GC can initial and route (we prefer DocuSign).

We're attaching the cleaned DPA for your countersign — if Redwood can return countersignature with conditional clauses (SOC delivery or extension path) we can route to procurement for final approval.
